characters.name: Lady Evelyn Vance
characters.persona: Sharp-tongued, glamorous heiress. At 8:30 PM, you had a furious public argument with Arthur about being disinherited and shouted, 'You'll regret this before nine!'
characters.secret: At 8:50 PM, you snuck along the Upstairs Gallery to eavesdrop outside the Study door and heard TOTAL SILENCE inside—not a sound until Arthur's voice boomed at 8:55 PM!
characters.clue: Two days ago, you heard Arthur recording that exact angry phrase ('You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!') onto a blank brass phonograph cylinder for his memoirs.
characters.detention: Searched from Lady Evelyn's Clutch: A crumpled furious letter ('I won't let you ruin this family tonight'), PLUS a note in Evelyn's hand: '8:50 PM — Stood in the Upstairs Gallery outside Arthur's Study door. Complete silence inside until 8:55 PM.'

dialogues.line: "Don't play innocent with me! I saw you slipping out of Arthur's Study around 8:05 PM looking like you'd seen a ghost. What were you doing in there?"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Wait a second—a brass wax cylinder?! Two days ago I heard Arthur recording that exact line—'You've gone too far! I'm calling the police'—for his memoirs! Could the Automaton have played it?!"

"I snuck along the Upstairs Gallery to eavesdrop outside the Study door at 8:50 PM and heard TOTAL SILENCE inside! Think back—did anyone hand Arthur something right before he locked himself in at 8:45?"

characters.name: Clara Sterling
characters.special: SPECIAL ABILITY (BLACKOUT PHASE): During each Blackout, if you are NOT Detained, the Host wakes you alone to secretly read ONE guest's Sealed Detention Card for 12 seconds!
characters.persona: Composed, razor-sharp attorney retained since 2005. You drafted Arthur's New Will and serve as the room's anchor for facts and timelines.
characters.secret: You advised Arthur AGAINST publishing Archive Box #4 (the 2008 transparency audit) in his New Will because you knew it would put a target on his back. You also brought a miniature field chemistry kit in your bag, which you will use between Acts II and III to produce Exhibit F (testing the wine vs. Arthur's cuff).

The 2008 Dossier Ledger and Arthur's Horologist Journal in that archive will prove who had 2008 access and whether his watch ever lost time. You also did a headcount in the Grand Hall at 9:00 PM and noticed someone was missing during the blackout.
characters.detention: Searched from Clara's Briefcase: A confidential memo from Arthur dated yesterday: 'Clara — Do NOT remove the 2008 Archive Box #4 clause. Eighteen years of silence ends tonight.' Also tucked inside: a miniature field chemistry testing kit.

dialogues.line: "I did a headcount in the Grand Hall when the clock struck nine. You weren't there. Where exactly were you when the lights went out?"

dialogues.target: Say to Nadia Vance (#18) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Wait a second—Exhibit D's Study re-inspection shows Arthur was slumped face-down at 9:01 PM, yet you claimed you saw his pale lips the instant the lights returned—and the puddle was odorless water, not wine!"

dialogues.target: Say to Victor Vance (#5) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "My field test found chloral hydrate—sleeping powder—in the red wine decanter. Exhibit F proves Arthur never drank it, so tell the truth right now and help us catch the real killer!"

characters.name: Thomas Graves
characters.persona: Dignified, observant butler who notices everything and speaks quietly. You have served Ravenshollow Manor since 1999.
characters.secret: You skimmed small sums from the wine cellar budget for your sister's medical bills (making you nervous about wine questions), though you are innocent of murder.
characters.clue: 1) At 8:40 PM a piping-hot cup of chamomile tea was poured in the Study—by 9:02 PM the untouched cup was barely lukewarm. 2) At 8:42 PM, YOU PERSONALLY SAW Nadia Vance (#18) hand Arthur a custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper in the Grand Hall right before Arthur locked himself in the Study!
characters.detention: Searched from Thomas Graves's Belongings: Tonight's handwritten note: '8:40 PM — Poured hot cup of chamomile tea in Study. 8:42 PM — Watched Nadia Vance (#18) hand Arthur a custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper in the Grand Hall. 9:02 PM — Tea untouched & barely lukewarm; watch smashed at 8:48 PM.'

dialogues.line: "Something about this 9:00 PM timeline doesn't add up—Arthur's pocket watch smashed at 8:48 PM, and the chamomile tea poured at 8:40 was untouched and barely lukewarm by 9:02!"
"The wine glass on Arthur's desk was completely full. What troubles me is the single cup of hot chamomile tea poured at 8:40 PM—by 9:02 PM, it was untouched and barely lukewarm!"
"Think back! At 8:42 PM in the Grand Hall, I personally watched Nadia Vance (#18) hand Arthur a custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper—and Arthur carried it straight up to his locked Study!"

characters.name: Dr. Julian Mercer
characters.persona: Calm, composed physician who has looked after Arthur's health for years. At 8:55 PM, you were standing right beside Nadia Vance (#18) in the Grand Hall when Arthur's voice boomed from upstairs.

characters.clue: You know Arthur's heart was stable at dinner and that fast-acting Aconite is completely odorless—unlike cyanide's bitter-almond smell.
characters.detention: Searched from Dr. Mercer's Medical Bag: A leather vial case with 6 sealed Heart Tonic vials (all intact) and an off-the-books insomnia prescription for Lord Arthur.

dialogues.line: "As Arthur's physician, I can swear his heart was completely stable at dinner. Whatever killed him tonight behind that locked door was fast-acting foul play, not natural failure."

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling (#2) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "Something about that 'bitter-almond' claim makes zero medical sense. Cyanide smells of bitter almonds, yes—but Exhibit D's Study re-inspection says the puddle had no scent at all! An odorless plant poison fits far better than cyanide."

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Exhibit F confirms concentrated Aconite—fatal in two to three minutes. If Arthur collapsed at 8:48 PM, it entered his system right around 8:45 PM from whatever he carried into the Study!"

characters.name: Victor Vance
characters.persona: Charming, desperate nephew who owes $400,000 to dangerous creditors and desperately needed Arthur's inheritance.
characters.secret: RED HERRING! At 7:58 PM, you snuck into the Dining & Sideboard and put CHLORAL HYDRATE (non-lethal sleeping powder) into Arthur's 1998 Bordeaux wine decanter before a glass was carried up to his Study, then slipped into the Study around 8:05 PM to locate the New Will! You're terrified you killed him—until Exhibit F proves he never drank the wine!
characters.clue: Once Exhibit F drops in Act III, confess to the sleeping powder so the room stops wasting votes on you and hunts the real killer!
characters.detention: Searched from Victor Vance's Belongings: A folded white paper packet labeled 'Chloral Hydrate (Sleep Aid)' and a desperate note about stealing the unsigned New Will.

dialogues.line: "Keep your voice down! People are whispering about the wine—yes, I stepped into the Study around 8:05 PM to talk to Arthur, and he wasn't even there!"
"Between us—did Lord Arthur drink any of that red wine tonight? Nadia Vance claimed it smelled of poison, and I'm worried..."

dialogues.target: Confess to Clara Sterling (#2) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Fine! I put sleeping powder—chloral hydrate—in the Bordeaux decanter in the Dining & Sideboard at 7:58 PM to steal the Will! NOT Aconite! And Exhibit F proves he NEVER DRANK THE WINE! I'm a thief, not a murderer!"

characters.name: Jasper Moore
characters.special: YOU ARE ON THE SHADOW TEAM! You are allied with Nadia Vance (#18) and win ONLY if the Killer escapes indictment in the Final Verdict. Fellow accomplices: Celeste Moreau (#7), Harriet Vance-Cole (#8). Wake up with the Shadow Team during Blackout Phases.

characters.detention: Searched from Jasper Moore's Belongings: A torn corner of a 2008 file folder and a folded slip: 'N.V. — Keep everyone focused on the wine tonight. Archive Box #4 stays shut.'

"You've been sweating since 9:01 PM! Everybody knows you slipped into the Study around 8:05—stop trying to pin this on a clockwork toy and admit what you put in that wine!"

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Even if Exhibit F found Aconite, trace residue can transfer from anything in a crowded hall—it doesn't prove Nadia Vance killed Arthur! Don't let an 18-year-old audit blind you!"

characters.name: Celeste Moreau
characters.special: YOU ARE ON THE SHADOW TEAM! You are allied with Nadia Vance (#18) and win ONLY if the Killer escapes indictment in the Final Verdict. Fellow accomplices: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8), Jasper Moore (#6). Wake up with the Shadow Team during Blackout Phases.

You didn't know Nadia Vance was going to murder Arthur, but if Nadia Vance goes down, you go to prison as an accessory. characters.clue: STRATEGY: Deflect suspicion onto Victor Vance (#5) and defend Nadia Vance's (#18) 8:55 PM Grand Hall alibi!

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit C]:

characters.name: Harriet Vance-Cole
characters.special: YOU ARE ON THE SHADOW TEAM! You are allied with Nadia Vance (#18) and win ONLY if the Killer escapes indictment in the Final Verdict. Fellow accomplices: Celeste Moreau (#7), Jasper Moore (#6). Wake up with the Shadow Team during Blackout Phases.
characters.persona: Sharp-eyed retired magistrate long estranged from Arthur—everyone assumes it was over principle, though the truth about 2008 is far darker.
characters.secret: You are secretly tied to Nadia Vance's (#18) 2008 cover-up and helped keep the upstairs gallery clear from 8:10–8:20 PM while Nadia Vance rigged the Automaton. Protect Nadia Vance in Town Hall votes!

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves (#3) [after Exhibit C]:

"Look, Nadia Vance, I don't care what a dusty 2008 ledger says—you were standing right beside Dr. Julian Mercer in the Grand Hall when Arthur was shouting at 8:55! Tell everyone how you could possibly be in two places at once!"

characters.name: Margot Bell

characters.name: Sebastian Cole

characters.name: Lydia Vance
characters.persona: Icy, ambitious, and furious with Victor (#5) for gambling away your savings.
characters.secret: At 8:35 PM near the basement stairs, you overheard two people whispering furiously: 'Fifteen seconds of dark at nine sharp, or your secret goes to the police!'

"Funny thing—at 8:35 PM near the basement stairs, I overheard two people whispering furiously: 'Fifteen seconds of dark at nine sharp, or your secret goes to the police!' Care to tell me who was blackmailing you?"

characters.name: Father Silas Ward
characters.persona: Gentle, solemn parish priest who has been Arthur Vance's spiritual confessor for twenty years.
characters.secret: Last Tuesday, Arthur confessed he had spent eighteen years 'shielding a guilty soul from a 2008 sin.' Bound by the Seal of Confession, you speak in pointed truths.

dialogues.target: Say to Victor Vance (#5) [after Exhibit E]:

characters.name: Beatrice (Bea) Holloway

"The upstairs laundry chute is in the second-floor hall near the Grand Staircase—someone hastily ditched evidence from the Study at 9:04 PM before anyone could search their pockets!"

dialogues.line: "I pulled a crumpled linen handkerchief with faint botanical residue from the basement laundry bin beneath the chute at 9:04 PM! Whoever rushed to Arthur's body first at 9:01 pocketed it from the Study and dumped it down the chute!"

characters.name: Gideon Thorne

"Arthur and I were business rivals, not enemies to the death. If you want to know why the lights died at nine, stop blaming the storm—someone in this house blackmailed an accomplice into pulling the breaker!"
"A man is dead! Whoever blackmailed you tonight used your 9:00 PM blackout as cover for a murder that happened twelve minutes earlier—save yourself before you take the fall!"

characters.name: Vivienne Sterling
characters.persona: Meticulous, ambitious junior attorney who personally typed up Arthur's New Will this afternoon.
characters.secret: You secretly copied the corporate restructuring pages onto a thumb drive to shop to a rival firm—shady ambition, NOT murder.
characters.clue: At 4:00 PM today in the Library, you caught someone alone reading Page 14 (the 2008 Archive Box #4 clause) of the New Will—they went pale as a ghost!
characters.detention: Searched from Vivienne's Portfolio: A 4:00 PM legal sticky note: 'Caught someone alone reading Page 14 (2008 Archive Box #4 clause) of the New Will in the Library. They looked terrified.'

dialogues.line: "I typed up the New Will myself this afternoon. Arthur added the Archive Box #4 release clause at the very last minute—whoever read Page 14 at 4:00 PM realized they had until 9:00 PM to stop him!"

dialogues.target: Say to Victor Vance (#5) [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "You didn't even know about Page 14's 2008 clause, did you? You only cared about the inheritance. Look at Exhibit E—the real killer was terrified of Archive Box #4!"

characters.name: Nadia Vance
characters.special: YOU ARE THE KILLER! Win by avoiding indictment in the Final Verdict (frame Celeste Moreau #7 or Victor Vance #5!). Your Shadow Team allies: Celeste Moreau (#7), Harriet Vance-Cole (#8), Jasper Moore (#6). During Blackouts, wake up to Intimidate 1 guest OR Plant a False Lead.

Tonight: at 8:15 PM you rigged the Chronos Automaton (8:55 PM voice + 9:00 PM carafe smash) and tried to burn the 2008 audit log in the Study fireplace; at 8:35 PM you blackmailed Celeste Moreau (#7) to cut the generator at 9:00 PM; at 8:42 PM you handed Arthur a custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper laced with concentrated Aconite (he died at 8:48 PM). You stood next to Dr. Julian Mercer (#4) at 8:55 PM for an alibi, then rushed to the desk at 9:01 PM—pocketing the custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper (and dropping your botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute at 9:04 PM) while slipping up by claiming you saw his chalk-pale lips (he was face-down!), smelled 'bitter-almond wine,' and lied about the 8:48 PM watch.

characters.detention: Searched from Nadia Vance's Effects: A folded dinner napkin smudged with faint fireplace soot and an unsigned note in Nadia Vance's handwriting: "Speak to Arthur privately before the 9:00 PM announcement—he cannot open that 2008 file tonight."

"I rolled Arthur over at 9:01 to check his pulse—pure reflex! Don't get distracted by a half-burned 2008 page; ask Celeste Moreau why the lights conveniently died at nine!"

"Yes, I handed Arthur a custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper at 8:42 PM—completely harmless! If his watch stopped at 8:48, he must have dropped it before arguing at 8:55. Don't fall for a frame-up!"

characters.name: Capt. Roderick Hale
characters.persona: Booming, weathered retired naval navigator stranded at the manor by the washed-out bridge.
characters.secret: You're obsessed with precision timekeeping—at 8:55 PM you checked your U.S. Naval Observatory chronometer against the manor's Grand Clock (dead-on to the second).
characters.clue: Yesterday afternoon at the pier, you synced your naval chronometer with Arthur's pocket watch! Arthur's watch did NOT run 12 minutes slow—whoever claimed that in Act I was LYING!
characters.detention: Searched from Capt. Hale's Pea Coat: A brass U.S. Naval Observatory chronometer and harbor log: '14:00 — Synchronized with Arthur Vance. His gold pocket watch is accurate to ±0.1 sec.'

dialogues.line: "Hold everything! Someone just claimed Arthur's pocket watch ran twelve minutes slow? Hogwash! I synced my U.S. Naval Observatory chronometer with Arthur's watch at the pier yesterday—dead-on to the second!"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "If Arthur's watch never lost a second and smashed at 8:48 PM, then whoever we heard yelling at 8:55 PM wasn't Arthur—unless ghosts can shout through oak doors, it had to be that brass cylinder!"

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling (#2) [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "Arthur's Horologist Journal in Exhibit E backs me up 100%! His watch stopped at 8:48 PM—which means whoever snapped that watch lid shut and called it 'twelve minutes slow' lied to this entire room!"

characters.name: Alistair Finch
characters.persona: Theatrical, scatterbrained ghostwriter living at the manor for two months to write Arthur's tell-all memoirs.

characters.detention: Searched from Alistair's Notebook: Nov 17 shorthand notes: 'Recorded Arthur's Ch. 12 quote onto brass cylinder (You've gone too far! I'm calling the police!). Subject: 2008 Archive Box #4 cover-up.'

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau (#7) [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "I personally helped Arthur record Chapter 12 onto a blank brass cylinder two days ago and watched him set it beside the Automaton! If that cylinder is inside Exhibit D, someone swapped it to fake his voice!"

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling (#2) [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "Arthur fired me yesterday just for peeking at his sealed Archive Box #4! Chapter 12 of his memoir was all about that 2008 cover-up—and Exhibit E finally names the culprit he was protecting!"

exhibits.title: Exhibit A — Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• Door & Window: Heavy oak double-door bolted from the inside; cliff window latched inside.
  • The Body: Lord Arthur Vance slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Nadia Vance (#18) at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Nadia Vance (#18) loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • On the Desk: Unsigned New Will; a crystal wine glass; a single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); a broken pocket watch.
  • On the Floor: Shattered glass beside a heavy 5-lb brass counterweight in a pool of spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Exhibit B — Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Nadia Vance (#18) snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

exhibits.title: Exhibit C — Charred Audit Log ('C.M.' / 'N.V.')
exhibits.html:

exhibits.html:

  • Release Cam: Drops a 5-lb brass counterweight at 9:00 PM (shifted 2 inches to strike the water carafe).
  • Cylinder Label: Reads "9:00 PM Gala Greeting" — hastily glued over a scratched-out title: "Memoir Draft — Confrontation."
  • Study Re-Inspection (Clear Light): The crystal wine glass on the desk is completely full & untouched; the shattered glass on the floor is a water carafe in clear, odorless liquid (zero wine, zero bitter-almond scent). Desk-blotter impressions confirm Arthur collapsed face-down, facing away from the door until Nadia Vance (#18) rolled him over.

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

act1.sub: Read Public Opener, unlock Exhibits A & B, mingle (7m), then Vote (3m) & Blackout (1m).
act1.html:
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Nobody touch a thing! The oak door was bolted from the inside, and the window drops eighty feet to the rocks. How on earth could someone kill him in a locked room?"
Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
"He was shouting at someone at 8:55! We all heard him! Then at 9:00 the lights went out and—my God, was that a gunshot?"
Nadia Vance (#18)
"There is no bullet wound. It was poison! The moment the lights came back on at 9:01, I saw Arthur's chalk-pale lips and smelled that unmistakable bitter-almond scent from the spilled wine. He died right around nine."
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Begging your pardon, but when I stepped beside the desk, I noticed Lord Arthur's pocket watch had smashed on the corner—its hands were stopped at 8:48."
Nadia Vance (#18)
"Ah, yes, I closed the lid so it wouldn't upset everyone. Arthur's watch always ran twelve minutes slow—he told me so himself just yesterday."
Clara Sterling (#2)
"Slow or not, the New Will is still on his desk—unsigned. Whoever wanted Arthur dead before 9:00 PM is standing in this room."

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-2948)

The Killer: Nadia Vance (#18)
The Accomplices (Shadow Team): Celeste Moreau (#7), Harriet Vance-Cole (#8), Jasper Moore (#6)
The Inspector: Clara Sterling (#2)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper handed to him by Nadia Vance (#18) at 8:42 PM. At 9:01 PM, Nadia Vance rushed to the desk first, pocketing the custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper and later ditching a botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute.

Victor Vance (#5) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Celeste Moreau (#7) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the custom botanical sleep-tincture dropper; (3) Nadia Vance slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C flagged both "C.M." and "N.V.", but Exhibit E clears Celeste Moreau (no 2008 access) and ties Nadia Vance directly to 2008 Lab Grant — Fabricated Clinical Dataset — Vance Junior Lab Fellow (2008)!
